sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for diagnostic testing associated with iron homeostasis and metabolism.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive.

Diagnostic Testing UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of Serum hepcidin testing, including immunoassays and GlycA testing to monitor transferrin or other glycosylated proteins for iron homeostasis and metabolism.

subsections.title: Diagnostic Testing
subsections.content: UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of Serum hepcidin testing, including immunoassays and GlycA testing to monitor transferrin or other glycosylated proteins for iron homeostasis and metabolism.
